name: Pyromancer
desc: Fire Mark burn deals 50% more. The foundation of every Fire build.

name: Deep Freeze
desc: The Freeze reaction lasts 3s instead of 2s.

name: Thunderclap
desc: The Conduct reaction chains to 2 more targets (4 -> 6).

name: Water Vein
desc: Water Marks spread to 1 adjacent enemy - priming a reaction across the pack.

name: Toxicologist
desc: Poison Marks stack up to 8 times instead of 5.

name: Landlord
desc: Element veins cost 25% less in the shop.

name: Wandering Smith
desc: Equipment costs 30% less in the shop.

name: Alchemist's Craft
desc: Every 15 elemental reactions grant a random potion.

name: Pure Steel
desc: Pieces NOT standing on an element vein gain +35% damage. The reward for a Pure Steel build.

name: Ley Weaver
desc: Element veins cost 15% less and every Earth Mark deals 30% more damage.
